name: Bronx House Day Camp
description_short: Bronx House day camp held on the 100 acre Henry Kaufmann Campgrounds in Rockland County, with groups from entering 1st grade to teens. Campers swim twice a day and do archery, yoga, boating, high ropes, nature, summer learning and sports, with two day trips a week; most ride camp buses from the Bronx.

fees.name: Bus pick up and drop off

notes: Prices are the community (non member) rate: full summer $4,050, half session $2,460, or weekly with a two week minimum at $1,300 for the first two weeks and $650 for each added week, plus a $50 insurance fee. Bronx House members pay $3,850 full, $2,375 half, $1,190 and $595 weekly. Groups: Fun Bunch (entering grades 1 to 2), Adventurers (3 to 4), Explorers (5 to 6), Teen Camp (7 to 10 on the camp page; ages 13 and 14 on the 2027 form). Camp hours about 7:35 am to 5:45 pm depending on bus. Black Friday special of $500 off full or half session, November 27 to 29, 2026.

for_andrew: Bronx House runs this camp for Bronx families: buses leave from Bronx House and Bronx neighborhood stops, and the site names no Rockland pick up or drop off. List it for Rockland families?
